name: K Laser Technology Inc.
summary: K Laser Technology Inc., along with its affiliated entities, conducts research, development, production, and sales of various holographic goods, primarily catering to the market in Mainland China. The company's product portfolio encompasses a range of holographic items, including specialized films, foils for both hot and cold stamping applications, holographic papers, security labels, and optical films. Furthermore, K Laser provides security solutions and is engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of optical instrumentation and equipment, alongside mechanical equipment for wireless communication. The company also extends its operations by acting as an agent for the sale of other holographic products. Founded in 1988, K Laser Technology Inc. has its main office located in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
